policy: All profiles share fresh v5 ingestion, verified lifecycle operations, source erasure, semantic implicit transitions, temporal normalization, a 32-item/6000-token evidence limit and fixed Answer/Judge. Facts disables dedicated raw-source candidates; sources enables them; rerank adds candidate reranking; coverage adds diversity packing. Relation expansion and event projection remain off for this E2/E3 ladder. The verification model judges erasure scope and compatible/exclusive/uncertain implicit transitions using source witness indexes; uncertain relationships preserve both grounded statements as unresolved while erasure authorization remains strict inside the same total 90-second model budget. Reuse ingestion only after every original add succeeds and all source/configuration identity checks pass. No migration or ingestion reuse from older source formats. Exposed development data is regression data, not a new holdout. All failures stay in the planned question denominator; three independent full paired repeats and a new dataset are still required. Source erasure covers at most 256 candidates/256000 candidate characters, partitioned into batches of at most 64 candidates/64000 JSON input characters. All batches share the original deadline and one atomic commit plan; missing or uncertain partitions reject the whole write. The source_erasure_v4 model protocol returns whole-source effects or unique nonoverlapping erase quotes for mixed sources. The server reconstructs and validates the complete original-text partition; uncertain ownership or mixed facts still reject. Exact repeated source and boundary payloads are transmitted once in reference tables; all original fields and candidate relationships remain represented. Batch limits measure actual packed input JSON. Reason categories are fixed and checked against their effect, avoiding verbose repeated explanations without dropping erasure witnesses. Deterministic target-scope and authorization source errors are repaired together within the same two-round limit. Facts already certified erased by the preceding erasure plan are excluded from redundant source-stage fact comparisons; every associated raw source remains independently reviewed. Commit revalidates both plans and the exact verified-erased set. Source input includes linked fact witnesses as context, never automatic retention exemptions; independent current decisions beside deletion commands must retain their evidence. State-transition source quotes have explicit zero-based slot labels; out-of-range references still reject. At most one additional source quote patch call per request can repair up to eight missing or ambiguous literal quotes while preserving all classified effects and candidate coverage. Every semantic verdict in the batch must already be resolved; unresolved quote repairs reject. This separate format patch shares the original total deadline and does not increase the two proposal-repair rounds. Linked certified-erased fact witnesses accompany surviving witnesses in source context. Commit rejects a newly erased fact when all its located literal source witnesses remain unchanged. This is a necessary cross-plan consistency guard, not proof of complete semantic deletion; it never automatically widens cuts into independent neighbors. Initial extraction visits every participant in explicit message_groups, using stable message-local new handles resolved by the server. All groups, including empty groups, still undergo unchanged independent semantic coverage verification. Local semantic patches use the existing flattened schema. No budget increase and no previously failed ingestion reuse. Compared with the message-groups candidate, only extraction model routing changes from gpt-5.4-mini to gpt-5.5; verification, repair, Answer, Judge and all time limits remain fixed. This is exposed-data development, not a demonstrated quality improvement. Initial extraction uses server-built lossless sentence/span reference tables instead of copying fact quotes. The server resolves each selected span to exact original text and UTF-16 positions before unchanged independent semantic verification. Only same-message operation target facts may use a unique exact literal subclause when full-span evidence would cross the authorizing command. References are provenance, not semantic proof. Repairs retain the flattened patch protocol and original messages. Default production format remains unchanged. Source operations use a separate pre-extraction verification stage for direct rejection of unrecorded assistant assertions within the current chunk. Exact targets, authorization, cuts and fact overlaps are checked again at commit. Requires new v6 directories. Current-chunk only: historical source targets and linked fact targets still require ordinary erasure binding. Flat extraction is used initially to preserve surviving subclauses beside resolved instructions; this is a new composite experiment, not isolated source-reference comparison.
